sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 21 §8.3.1.4 volatile Fields
Java Language Specification SE 21 §14.19 The synchronized Statement
Java Language Specification SE 21 Chapter 17 Threads and Locks
Java Language Specification SE 21 §15.14.2 Postfix Increment Operator ++

claims.text: JLS SE 21 specifies that synchronized acquires a mutual-exclusion monitor lock; while the executing thread owns the lock no other thread may acquire that same lock, and normal or abrupt completion releases it.

JLS SE 21 classifies volatile reads/writes and monitor lock/unlock as synchronization actions; monitor unlock synchronizes-with later lock on the same monitor, and a volatile write synchronizes-with subsequent reads of the same volatile variable, yielding the corresponding happens-before relationships.

JLS SE 21 defines volatile as a field-level synchronization mechanism for consistent visibility of the variable and contrasts it with exclusive lock use; volatile itself does not establish ownership of a mutual-exclusion critical section.

JLS SE 21 specifies postfix increment as obtaining the variable value, adding one, and storing the sum back; combining that multi-step expression with volatile field semantics does not introduce the monitor mutual exclusion required to make the whole read-modify-write sequence a single critical section.

JLS SE 21 notes that acquiring an object's lock does not itself prevent other threads from accessing fields or unsynchronized methods; mutual-exclusion correctness therefore depends on all relevant accesses following the same synchronization protocol.

The JLS contract is expressed in synchronization actions, synchronization order, synchronizes-with, and happens-before relations; the candidate intentionally does not assert a fixed HotSpot or CPU instruction/barrier sequence as part of Java language semantics.

findings: 候选按互斥、happens-before、复合原子性、适用条件和实现边界统一比较 synchronized 与 volatile，直接回答所有来源问法。
对唯一 L2 原理来源问法补足 monitor 与 volatile 发布的状态链路，并用 JLS 的 postfix increment 语义说明 volatile++ 的复合操作边界，而非依赖泛化博客结论。
内存屏障部分严格停留在 JMM 规范契约，未把特定 HotSpot/JIT/CPU 的屏障或指令序列写成跨版本事实；无硬失败。
